audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer level chart carried a blanket 'Skill' on all seven rows while the content layer and the packet both read Zed on rows 0-5 and Akali on row 6.
audit.why: Five Point Strike costs 110 energy at rank 1 and reaches only 550 while your Shadow Slash-plus-auto pattern chips for free, so Zed owns the early lane; Twilight Shroud at 16s and Perfect Execution at 60s by rank 3 flip the duel two items in.
audit.corrected: phases[0..5].side=Zed, phases[6].side=Akali, matching win[0..6] already on disk.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spikes prose named no cooldown, so the level 6 and first-item windows had no shape.
audit.why: Akali's R is 120/90/60 — the spike that ends Zed's window is her rank-3 R, not a generic 'answer'.
audit.corrected: breakdown.spikes now names the 60s R as the closing of your kill window.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two decisive interactions were absent. Twilight Shroud makes Akali unable to be selected by spells and attacks (target lock breaks), and Shuriken Flip marks the smoke cloud itself, so she can re-dash back to the shroud. Assassin's Mark is an auto-attack reset — the empowered wind-up, not a spell cast, is the tell. Perfect Execution's recast executes on a threshold.
audit.why: Riot text: 'unable to be selected by enemy spells and attacks'; 'The first enemy or smoke cloud hit is marked. Re-cast to dash to the marked target'; 'executing all enemies she strikes'.
audit.corrected: Shroud/E re-dash stated in dosFull[1].d, the auto reset tell in dontsFull[2].d, the execute threshold in dontsFull[0].d.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digit in it (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT).
audit.why: It is the field that holds real numbers.
audit.corrected: Shroud 20s at rank 1 to 16s at rank 5, Perfect Execution 120s at rank 1, Living Shadow 20s.

audit.whatIsWrong: 16 lint findings: 11 misgendered fields calling Akali he/his/him, 2 copy-paste bleeds, 1 numberless cooldown field.
audit.why: Akali is female per champ-gender.js; dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d were the tradeGood/tradeBad strings pasted under unrelated titles.
audit.corrected: Pronouns fixed and both bleeding bullets rewritten to match their own titles.

audit.whatIsWrong: QA pass: matchup-lint and regression-check still reported findings on this matchup after the proposing pass.
audit.why: Edits from the earlier pass were rejected by apply-proposals (length drift, or a phrase matching the non-interaction filter), so the defects survived on disk.
